objective: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

description: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
progress: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
completion: I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.
Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, <name>. And you will be commended.
